nodes.label: Graphify query, path, and explain
nodes.description: Commands named by the repository instructions: graphify query, graphify path, and graphify explain.

nodes.label: Graphify repository navigation instructions
nodes.description: For qualifying repository architecture or code-relationship questions, the instructions direct use of graphify query when graphify-out/graph.json exists, graphify path for relationships, and graphify explain for focused concepts. These instructions do not establish that the files or commands exist.

nodes.label: Graphify navigation artifacts
nodes.description: The instructions refer conditionally to graphify-out/graph.json, graphify-out/wiki/index.md, and graphify-out/GRAPH_REPORT.md.

nodes.label: /graphify
nodes.description: The instructions tell users to type /graphify in Copilot Chat to build or update the graph.

nodes.label: Retry policy formulation
nodes.description: Compute retry limits and exponential backoff using T = B * 2^n, apply jitter of ±25%, and inspect Retry-After headers.

nodes.label: Retry invariants
nodes.description: Do not retry unsafe non-idempotent requests without request-idempotency tokens; include randomized jitter; clamp the maximum backoff ceiling to avoid infinite worker thread starvation.

nodes.label: API Recovery & Resilience Skill
nodes.description: Documentation describes a skill for API failure diagnosis and recovery planning. Its front matter declares version 1.2.0, runtime ollama-gemma, and status active; these declarations do not establish that an implementation is present.

nodes.label: Safeguard verification
nodes.description: Evaluate downstream cascade risks, retry storms, thundering herds, and cache stampede vulnerabilities.

nodes.label: Failure diagnosis and error fingerprinting
nodes.description: Extract HTTP status codes 429, 500, 502, 503, and 504; error response bodies; TCP timeouts; or connection reset flags.

nodes.label: ollama-gemma
nodes.description: Runtime value declared in the skill's front matter. The documentation does not verify runtime availability or implementation.

nodes.label: Fallback strategy selection
nodes.description: Select among stale-while-revalidate cache reads, circuit breakers with graceful default payloads, secondary replica mirror failover, and queued asynchronous dead-letter replay.

nodes.label: Resilient Python wrapper synthesis
nodes.description: The skill specifies emitting production-ready Python resilient wrapper code with telemetry hooks. httpx, tenacity, and aiohttp are named as code-generation options, not verified project dependencies.

nodes.label: Recovery recommendation workflow
nodes.description: Classify timeout, HTTP 429, HTTP 5xx, or invalid-response failures; identify likely causes without inventing facts; recommend retry and fallback strategies; identify risks and safeguards; provide a checklist and illustrative Python code.

nodes.label: Safety rules and required output
nodes.description: Do not claim a real API was tested or repaired unless it was; distinguish simulated results from real network behavior; do not expose credentials or recommend infinite retries; explain trade-offs and risks. Required output comprises diagnosis, recovery strategy, retry policy, fallback plan, risks and safeguards, checklist, and suggested Python implementation.

nodes.label: API Recovery Skill
nodes.description: Documentation asks the skill to help diagnose API failures and design safe recovery strategies. It does not establish that application code implementing the skill exists.

nodes.label: Fallback guidance options
nodes.description: The documented options are cached_response (valid, suitably fresh cached result), secondary_provider (configured alternative provider), graceful_degradation (reduced functionality), and fail_safely (clear error without fabricated data).

nodes.label: Retry guidelines
nodes.description: Use exponential backoff with jitter where appropriate, respect Retry-After, set a maximum retry count, safeguard non-idempotent requests, and avoid retrying permanent client errors without correcting the request.
